newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls in bills Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls in bills Feb 5.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will auction four trillion roubles ($710.7 million) of 161-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22069) and seven trillion roubles of 287-day T-bills (series 22070) on February 5, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the auctions follow:
Full details of the T-bill auction series 22069
Full details of the T-bill auction series 22070
Both issues are new paper, which means that they are subject to a new tax on government securities.
It is still unclear whether profits from government securities will be taxed at a flat rate of 15 percent or at the usual profit tax rates of 35 and 43 percent.

On February 5 the finance ministry will also pay about 753.70 billion roubles in interest on an issue of OFZ inerest-bearing bond (series 24006) and repay about 6.48 trillion roubles in maturing six-month T-bills (series 22042).
